fix(hygiene): show odd file names as escapes in the report (T-028)

A .ts file name with a line feed, a control character or a direction
mark could split or reorder the one-line report. showPath() replaces the
characters the rule forbids, and tab and line feed, with the text of
their escape; describeRawInvisible, sourceProblems and the read-error
line use it (Qodo PR review finding 9fb45c26).

Merge pull request #3 from UBayouski/day-03-git-log-stream

feat: parse git log streams from stdin (T-002)

fix(gitlog): report junk before the SHA as malformed; strip PowerShell BOM

Qodo review finding: stripping all leading whitespace let a space- or
  tab-prefixed hash pass SHA validation. Only framing newlines are removed
  now. Narrowing the strip exposed that PowerShell 5.1 prepends a UTF-8 BOM
  to piped streams, which the old \s strip had been hiding; the BOM is now
  removed once per stream and documented. Two tests added.

feat: parse git log streams from stdin (T-002)

Adds parseGitLog and the 'tracenotes log' command. Input is the
  git log --format='%H%x1f%an%x1f%aI%x1f%B%x1e' stream. Invalid SHAs and
  short records go to a malformed list with a reason; count always equals
  commits + malformed. Dates stay strings with an ISO 8601 shape warning.
  Fixtures are marked binary so the LF policy leaves control bytes alone.
